facts.fact: The World Bank FSAP note says the Central Bank of Eswatini's 2019 Mobile Money Transfer Practice Note sets limited consumer-protection and conduct requirements for mobile money providers, which banks and mobile money providers have generally been complying with.
facts.system: Mobile Money Transfer (MMT) Practice Note No.1/2019/NPSS

facts.fact: The World Bank FSAP note says a CBE Ombudsman and an FSRA Ombudsman have been in place for several years taking complaints about credit, transaction and savings products, the CBE one without finalized procedural rules.
The World Bank FSAP note reports complaint figures from the ombudsman schemes' last annual reports: 40 complaints to the CBE Ombudsman and 84 to the FSRA Ombudsman, up from 59 the year before.

systems.system: Mobile Money Transfer (MMT) Practice Note No.1/2019/NPSS
